facts.business: Thermax Limited is a global energy and environment solutions company providing integrated portfolio of products, projects and services for clean air, clean energy and clean water across industries.
facts.related_party_note: Loans to First Energy Private Limited (subsidiary) of Rs 4.50 crore on August 4, 2025 and Rs 4.00 crore on August 4, 2025; subscription to rights issue of Thermax Bioenergy Solutions Private Limited increasing stake from 65% to 76.97%; acquisition of 23.03% stake in Thermax Bioenergy Solutions Private Limited from Everenviro Resource Management Private Limited on August 13, 2025 making it wholly owned subsidiary; acquisition of additional 35.83% stake in ExactSpace Technologies Private Limited on February 27, 2026, becoming subsidiary effective April 9, 2026; formation of Fortmax Chemicals India Private Limited with Oswaldo Cruz Química Indústria E Comércio LTDA, Brazil (51:49 JV) incorporated April 11, 2025.
